title: GATE 2024 CS (CS1) – Question 1
subject: General Aptitude
topic: Analytical Aptitude: Logical Reasoning, Deduction and Analogy
text: If '→' denotes increasing order of intensity, then the meaning of the words [dry → arid → parched] is analogous to [diet → fast → _________]. Which one of the given options is appropriate to fill the blank?
explanation:
The first sequence increases the severity of dryness: normal lack of water ("dry"), extreme dryness ("arid"), to severe desiccation ("parched").

The corresponding food sequence should progress from restricting food ("diet"), to completely abstaining from eating for a period ("fast"), to severe deprivation and life-threatening hunger ("starve").

Thus (A) starve is the correct answer. "Feast" is an antonym, while "reject" and "deny" do not describe escalating physiological hunger.

title: GATE 2024 CS (CS1) – Question 2
subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
text: Consider a Binary Search Tree (BST) constructed by inserting the following distinct integers one by one into an initially empty BST: 45, 23, 78, 12, 34, 67, 89, 56. Which of the following is the post-order traversal sequence of the resulting tree?
explanation:
Construct the BST step-by-step:
- Root = 45
- 23 < 45 (left child of 45)
- 78 > 45 (right child of 45)
- 12 < 23 (left child of 23)
- 34 > 23 (right child of 23)
- 67 < 78 (left child of 78)
- 89 > 78 (right child of 78)
- 56 < 67 (left child of 67)

Post-order traversal visits Left, Right, then Root:
- Left subtree of 23: 12
- Right subtree of 23: 34
- Node 23
=> (12, 34, 23)
- Right subtree of 45: Left subtree of 78 has (56, 67), right has 89, node 78
=> (56, 67, 89, 78)
- Finally root: 45
Resulting sequence: 12, 34, 23, 56, 67, 89, 78, 45.

title: GATE 2023 CS – Question 3
subject: Operating Systems
text: A counting semaphore S is initialized to 10. Then, 12 P (wait) operations and 7 V (signal) operations are completed on S in an arbitrary order. What is the current value of the semaphore S?
explanation:
Initial value of semaphore S = 10.
Each P operation decrements the semaphore value by 1.
Each V operation increments the semaphore value by 1.

Current value = Initial + (# of V operations) - (# of P operations)
Current value = 10 + 7 - 12 = 17 - 12 = 5.

Hence, option (A) is correct.
